_doc: T-292 analyst model settings. Pinned from the live Anthropic /v1/models listing on 2026-07-09 (efficient tier daily / stronger tier weekly, per the director). Model IDs are EXACT strings sent to the API; a drift is caught because provenance records model_id_requested vs model_id_served and validate_note re-checks. Prices are USD per MILLION tokens — best-known published values; the fail-closed $30/mo governor is the real budget guard (actual volume is <$2/mo at these tiers, so a price drift is immaterial to the cap). Reconcile against the billing console if precise accounting is ever needed.
